items.what: a small notebook with a dark leather cover, a strap and cream pages, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a lodestone: a dark, heavy, naturally magnetic stone about the size of a walnut that pulls at steel, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a small glass jar of honey with a cork stopper, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a dented red tin of lamp oil with a screw cap and a spout, about a quart, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a cloth bundle of food tied at the top: a small loaf of hard bread, a wedge of cheese, a strip of jerky and a handful of dried apple rings, left in the basket at the visitor stump
an old iron key about as long as Token's hand, crusted orange-brown with rust that comes off as powder on the fingers, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a large sheet of heavy cream paper, rolled up and tied with twine, big enough for a map
a yellow wooden pencil with a sharp point
a clear glass dome about a hand wide, the size to sit over the compass lid and keep the wind off the needle
a second net sack of knotted cord with a drawstring, the same make as his first

a big cloth bundle of food tied at the top, enough for several days of full meals: two round loaves of bread, a wheel of hard cheese, a ring of smoked sausage, a sack of roasted nuts and a few apples, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a treat: a small glass jar of honey with a cork stopper, with a few oat cookies wrapped in paper tied to its neck, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a dented red tin of lamp oil with a screw cap and a spout, a full quart, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a felling axe with a hickory handle and a keen steel head, leaning against the visitor stump
a handsaw with a wooden grip, laid across the basket at the visitor stump
a claw hammer in the basket at the visitor stump
a leather roll of three carving knives in the basket at the visitor stump: a long straight blade, a short stub for detail and a curved one for hollows

a pinhole camera for Token: a small wooden box with a lid, a brass plate on its front with a pin-sized hole in it and a sliding brass shutter, loaded with twelve sheets of paper, left in the basket at the visitor stump

a pinhole camera for Gage: a small wooden box with a lid, a brass plate on its front with a pin-sized hole in it and a sliding brass shutter, loaded with twelve sheets of paper, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a pocket notebook for Gage with a stiff gray cloth cover and squared pages, and a loop on its spine that holds a pencil, left in the basket at the visitor stump
a small wooden keg of iron nails, a few thousand of them in three lengths, left beside the basket at the visitor stump

a carpenter's wooden tool chest left at the visitor stump with a spade laid beside it; inside are a brace with a set of auger bits, two chisels and a wooden mallet, a try square, a folding rule, a spirit level, a plumb bob on a line and a pry bar

a big cloth bundle of food in the basket at the visitor stump: three round loaves, a wheel of hard cheese, two rings of smoked sausage, a sack of oats, a sack of dried beans, a bag of nuts, a string of dried apples, a small crock of salt and a jar of honey
